20261118-physics-g05.material: [E5 Uphenyo Lwefiziksi] Inkinga esebenzisa izimiso ze-Basics of Speed. Endaweni ebushelelezi engenakungqubuzana, amandla amileyo $F = 10\text{ N}$ asebenza entweni enesisindo $m = 2\text{ kg}$ ebangeni elingama-$4\text{ m}$. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle umsebenzi $W$ nokusheshisa $a$?
20261118-physics-g05.s.s1.prompt: [E5 Uphenyo Lwefiziksi] Inkinga esebenzisa izimiso ze-Basics of Speed. Endaweni ebushelelezi engenakungqubuzana, amandla amileyo $F = 10\text{ N}$ asebenza entweni enesisindo $m = 2\text{ kg}$ ebangeni elingama-$4\text{ m}$. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle umsebenzi $W$ nokusheshisa $a$?
20261118-physics-g05.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: Kusuka emthethweni wesibili ka-Newton $F = ma$, ukusheshisa $a = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{10\text{ N}}{2\text{ kg}} = 5\text{ m/s}^2$.
Isinyathelo 2: Umsebenzi owenziwe ngu-$W = F \cdot s = 10\text{ N} \times 4\text{ m} = 40\text{ J}$.
Isinyathelo 3: Ngakho-ke ukusheshisa kungu-$5\text{ m/s}^2$ kanti umsebenzi ngu-$40\text{ J}$.

20261121-physics-g05-1.title: Basics of Speed
20261121-physics-g05-1.goal: Sebenzisa izimiso ze-Basics of Speed ukuxazulula inkinga yophenyo.
20261121-physics-g05-1.material: [E5 Uphenyo Lwefiziksi (Okuthuthukile)] Ukuhlaziywa kokunyakaza kokuwa kwamahhala okuphathelene ne-Basics of Speed. Into iwuswa isuka ekuphumuleni endaweni engenalutho ngaphansi kwamandla adonsela phansi $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Ijubane $v$ nebanga $h$ eliwile emva kwesikhathi $t = 3\text{ s}$ liyini?
20261121-physics-g05-1.s.s1.prompt: [E5 Uphenyo Lwefiziksi (Okuthuthukile)] Ukuhlaziywa kokunyakaza kokuwa kwamahhala okuphathelene ne-Basics of Speed. Into iwuswa isuka ekuphumuleni endaweni engenalutho ngaphansi kwamandla adonsela phansi $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Ijubane $v$ nebanga $h$ eliwile emva kwesikhathi $t = 3\text{ s}$ liyini?
20261121-physics-g05-1.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: Ijubane $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Isinyathelo 2: Ibanga $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Isinyathelo 3: Ngakho-ke $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ kanti $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
